caption: The drawing depicts two silver-colored spoons placed vertically side by side against an off-white background. Each spoon is shown with the handle pointing downward and the bowl at the top. The left spoon has a plain, teardrop-shaped bowl with a smooth handle that features a subtle beaded or lined edge running along its border. The right spoon has a similar bowl shape, but the handle displays a decorative floral or leafy pattern near the bowl end, and what appears to be engraved initials or marks near the base of the handle. Both spoons are rendered in shades of gray, with shadows and highlights indicating their metallic surface. The background is minimal, with some scattered light spots and the name "David P. Willoughby" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Silver Teaspoon
